files.caption: Two photographs of 2921 Yankee Road, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are undated. The real estate listing for 2921 Yankee Road reads: A good home, situated on large lot,100 x 350 ft. Surrounded by beautiful shrubs and shade trees and some fruit trees. Plenty of privacy and comfort living in this home. The house consists of large living room with open fireplace, dining room, 2 large bedrooms with walk-in closets, hardwood floors, complete bath and a large well-arranged kitchen on first floor. Open
